summary: Adds release_checks arrays to extensions.yml: the new release-ceremony extension defines four release checks (notes complete, branch rebased, release issue open, extension sign-off). The marketing-site extension gains two release checks (copy reviewed, analytics consent). get_release_status() already reads release_checks via _load_extension_release_checks().
migration_impact: gh plate release status will now report outstanding extension release checks. No migration required — all additions are additive.
migration_guidance: 2. Run `gh plate release status --repo owner/repo` to see extension release checks in the output.
3. To add your own extension's release checks, follow the schema in .agentic/extensions.yml: release_checks is an array of {id, description, required, human_approval_required}.
4. Checks marked required: true will block release by convention; human_approval_required: true means a human must sign off.
agent_notes: Check gh plate release status before starting a release PR — it lists all outstanding extension release checks. Complete all required ones before merging release into main.
